description.en: The display name of the job.

description.zh: 查询区间的截止时间；使用任务的创建时间来过滤。
description.en: The end time of the query range. The job creation time is used for filtering.
Filters results by the time after which they were modified.

description.zh:
排序顺序。
- desc：降序。
- asc：升序。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:
- desc: descending order.
- asc: ascending order.

description.zh: 分页查询，指定当前需要返回的页码，从1开始往后编号。
description.en: The page number of the page to return in a paged query. Paging starts from page 1.

description.zh: 分页查询中，指定每页返回的RayHistoryServer数量。
description.en: The number of RayHistoryServer entries to return on each page in a paged query. Paging is used to return results in batches.

The billing method. Valid values:
- PrePaid
- PostPaid.

description.zh: 资源组ID。如何查询专有资源组ID，详情请参见[管理资源配额](~~2651299~~)。
description.en: The resource group ID. For information about how to query the ID of a dedicated resource group, see [Manage resource quotas](~~2651299~~).

description.zh: 是否只返回当前登录者所创建的RayHistoryServer。
description.en: Specifies whether to return only the RayHistoryServer entries created by the current user.

description.zh:
按返回的以下字段排序。
- DisplayName
- GmtCreateTime
- UserId
- ResourceId
- Status
- GmtModifyTime
description.en:
The field by which to sort the returned results. Valid values:
- DisplayName
- GmtCreateTime
- UserId
- ResourceId
- Status
- GmtModifyTime.

description.zh:
RayHistoryServer 状态：
- Creating：创建中。
- Queuing：排队中。
- Running：运行中。
- Stopped：已停止。
- Failed：已失败。
description.en:
The RayHistoryServer status. Valid values:
- Creating: being created.
- Queuing: waiting in queue.
- Running: running.
- Stopped: stopped.
- Failed: failed.
The storage path of Ray logs.

description.zh: 工作空间ID。<props="china">如何获取工作空间ID，请参见[ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。</props>
description.en: The workspace ID. <props="china">For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).</props>.

descriptions.en:
Before you use this operation, make sure that you are familiar with the billing and [pricing](~~171758~~) of Platform for AI - Deep Learning Containers (PAI-DLC).
><notice>The total length of the CreateJob operation parameters, including system-generated parameters, cannot exceed 65,536 bytes.></notice>.
